title: Flight Test
description: The Mandalorian isn't sure if he wants to abandon his dream of a new Razor Crest in favor of the modified N-1 Starfighter until he gives it a test flight. Taking it up over the skies of Mos Espa, across the old Podracing course made famous from Boonta Eve races, and dashing through Beggar's Canyon, the Mandalorian finds the ship to be faster and more maneuverable than he could have imagined.
